text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To let the exhausted T.M. Opera O get some 
rest, I brought her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Even the "Supreme King" must not push 
themselves too far. I'll see you later, 
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: "...Oh? Where on earth is this—"

text_block_list.name: Subject A
text_block_list.text:
"For the multifaceted and brilliant Opera 
O-sama, the Kingdom of Clever Opera O is 
the only fitting choice!"

text_block_list.name: Subject B
text_block_list.text:
"No, the noble and majestic Opera O-sama 
should be invited to the Grand Opera O 
Empire!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
...What a turn of events! To think two 
nations are fighting over me!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Cease this at once! Pointless conflict 
brings nothing but sorrow.

text_block_list.name: Crowd
text_block_list.text: Opera-sama!?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
No matter how much you yearn, I belong to 
myself alone. This is an absolute law of 
nature that not even the Three Goddesses 
can overturn!

text_block_list.name: Crowd
text_block_list.text: N-No way...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: "Ah, weep not, my nameless believers."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
By way of apology, at the very least... I 
hope that basking in my beauty will heal 
your wounds.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: "Feast your eyes! TM Opera Beeeeeeam!!!"

text_block_list.name: Subject A
text_block_list.text:
A-Amazing! Even the scenery around us 
looks like it's sparkling...!

text_block_list.name: Subject B
text_block_list.text:
What dazzling brilliance! I need to burn 
every single second of this into my 
memory!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
You understand now, don't you? There are 
things we must do rather than constantly 
bickering and building up hatred.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It is to praise that sublime masterpiece 
crafted by God— none other than T.M. Opera 
O!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now, worship and revere me to your heart's 
content! Ah-hah-hah... Huh?!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
A dream, was it... Heh, it seems I have 
birthed yet another legend of the "Supreme 
Overlord."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
TM Opera O, in high spirits, seemed to 
have completely recovered physically as 
well!

text_block_list.name: Crowd
text_block_list.text:
Gwaaaahhh!? I-It's so bright, I can't see 
a thing!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oh no! Is my radiance so blinding that you 
can't look directly at me?!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Pull it together! Everyone, 
EVERYOOONE—!!!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, was it just a dream?!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, what a pity, what a tragedy...! And 
all because I was just too beautiful!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Out of guilt, T.M. Opera O seemed unable 
to focus on resting.
